mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses the discount rate for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 55% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises by more than 0.3 percentage points over the past 3 months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger a flight to safety, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales growth signal a broad-based demand contraction, which triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 trading days as recession fears intensify.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60d returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.01 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production growth, the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days as supply chain disruptions and manufacturing slowdowns reduce corporate earnings prospects.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 50% of periods with declining INDPRO, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to maintain restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 45% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% YoY, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in employment growth, as measured by the monthly change in non-farm payrolls, signals a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 55% of periods with rising PAYEMS, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When the quarterly GDP growth rate falls below 1.0% annualized, it indicates a weakening economy that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate investment and consumer demand.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 50% of instances when GDPC1 < 1.0% annualized, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of rising federal funds rates above 3.0%, the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the tightening cycle increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 45% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.
